name: Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics (BMB) PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated BMB deadline; BBE page labeled applying 2026–2027 does not state an entry year.

english.note: English exams not required and no minimum score. Applicants without native English/English-instructed degree should demonstrate proficiency; TOEFL, PTE, IELTS and certified tests including Duolingo may be self-reported. Those without English-instructed degree evaluated before academic year and may need ESL. Exemptions include two years U.S. study or an English-instructed degree.

applicationFee.note: Hardship waiver within online application; income/expenses and circumstances requested, individually reviewed. No citizenship restriction stated; international applicants confirm eligibility.

documents: Statement of purpose written by applicant in English
School-issued scanned transcripts/grade reports from all colleges attended; complete certified English translations and grading legend where needed
requirements.note: Bachelor's or equivalent by matriculation; no second PhD. Only one Caltech option per cycle. No minimum GPA. GRE strongly recommended/encouraged, not required.

funding.note: All full-time PhD students offered tuition, mandatory fees and living stipend while making satisfactory progress, securing thesis advisor and meeting program requirements. Rate effective September 1, 2026; not confirmed Fall 2027 rate.

timeline.interviews: Sample undated timeline: initial Zoom interviews in December; selected campus visit in February.
